# P27.5 (LAUNCH.5) — Web data layer: wire every public surface to the export

**Spec:** `docs/tickets/P27.5__web-data-layer-wiring.md` · **Base:** `devin/p27-4-spine-backed-export-bundle`
(stacked PR) · **Requirements:** ADR-066, SIG-UI-036/037, the frozen P27.1 per-page contracts
(`docs/build/reports/PUBLIC_SURFACE_DATA_CONTRACTS.md`).

## Summary

Extends the single build-time data seam `web/src/lib/data.ts` so **every** public surface reads real
export bytes under `SIG_DATA_SOURCE=export`, closing the gap where the map / network / reference-* /
data-freshness / coverage / watch / evidence / corrections / research-queue pages imported committed
fixtures directly (making export mode a no-op for them). Fixtures stay the CI default; export mode
**fails loud** on a missing artifact — never a silent fixtures fall-back that would fabricate a surface.

## What changed

- **`web/src/lib/data.ts`** — nine typed surface getters mirroring the P27.1 contracts, each
  `fixtures | export` reading `<exportDir>/web/<artifact>.json` (the P27.4 web bundle) and throwing a
  loud, actionable error if the artifact is missing or malformed: `getMapSites`, `getNetwork`,
  `getFreshness`, `getCoverage`, `getWatch`, `getEvidence`, `getCorrections`, `getResearchQueue`,
  `getDossierIndex`. Plus a `capRows` build-time pagination helper and a documented section of
  auxiliary accessors (density bins, network centrality/ER-quality, decision point, capture diff,
  provenance summaries, jurisdiction claims, editorial constants, reference-page exemplars) that are
  **not** part of the frozen P27.1 export contract and so are served as committed constants in both
  modes — routed through the seam so no page imports a fixture directly (D-P27.5-1).
- **Pages** — repointed off direct `*-fixture.ts` imports onto the data layer: `map`, `network`,
  `reference-map`, `reference-graph`, `data-freshness`, `coverage-metrics`, `watch`, `corrections`,
  `research-queue`, `editorial-standards`, `style-guide`, `evidence/index`, `evidence/[id]`, and the
  `watch/[jurisdiction].ics|.xml` + `watch/citations.txt` routes. Rendering is byte-identical in
  fixtures mode, so the existing e2e/a11y suite is unaffected.
- **National scale (d3)** — `capRows` bounds the map's located-assets table and the freshness table at
  build time (210 sources; tens of thousands of sites) with an honest "showing N of M" note; the
  threshold (500) leaves fixtures untruncated. Detailed table shapes land in P27.7.
- **Verification harness (pure web)** — `web/scripts/build-fixture-export.ts` + `npm run export:fixtures`
  serialise the committed fixtures into the P27.1 export layout, so export mode is exercised against
  **real on-disk bytes** with fixture-equivalent content (the P21.4 precedent) without a hosted spine.
- **`tests/e2e/test_composed_stack.py`** — the S8 export-build fixture now overlays the ten surface
  JSONs onto its `--jurisdiction okc` bundle (leaving the real dossiers/leverage/tiles untouched), so
  the export-mode web build has a complete bundle. Test-only; the `exports/` producer is unchanged.

## Design decisions

- **Fail-loud, never a silent fixtures fall-back** in export mode — mirrors the existing
  `getDossiers`/`getLeverageMetric` pattern. A missing artifact is a build error (proven).
- **The presentation analytics the P27.1 contract omits** (density bins, centrality/ER-quality, and
  page-scoped constants) are routed through the seam as both-mode committed constants rather than being
  invented into the export. This is honest (they carry no export artifact and render identically in both
  modes) and recorded as **D-P27.5-1** for a future emit-or-ratify decision (P27.7 / a spine analytics pass).
- **Zero export-shape change** (P27.4 owns them); **no islands/JS** (P27.9); **no nav/IA/landing**
  redesign (P27.6); **no empty-state/visual polish** (P27.7).
